transcript: Four things I'd ban from my home immediately. Not because I fear them, but because I understand how quietly they steal life from the body. Your home should heal you, not poison you, number one. Microwave popcorn bags. They look harmless. But those bags are lined with forever chemicals that never leave your body. They disturb your hormones and weaken your inner fire. Take your popcorn like your grandmother did in a pan with coconut oil and sea salt. When food is touched by your hands, it becomes medicine. Number two, scented candles. They promise peace, yet they burn invisible toxins that enter your lungs and spirit. True fragrance comes from nature, sandalwood, herbs, or pure essential oils. When the scent is pure, your air becomes healing. Number three, air fresheners and plug-ins. Ah, these are silent destroyers. They fill your home with chemical perfume that clouds your breath and disturbs your hormones. If you want true freshness, open your windows and let the plants cleanse your air. Number four, bright white lights at night. Your body follows the rhythm of the sun and moon. Blue light after sunset tells your brain the day isn't over, blocking melatonin and stealing your rest. At night, use warm golden light. Let your body remember the moon. Remove these four things and your home will start to heal you again. Your breath, your sleep, your peace, all will return. If you wish to go deeper into ancient healing and restore balance to your body and home, you can find my Wisdom e-book in the link on my profile. And if you're from the US or any Western country, comment below. I want to see how many of you are starting this healing journey with me.
